unit: 2c Core content of A Level Art and Design
outcome: Engage in integrated critical, practical and theoretical study in art and design.

unit: 2c Core content of A Level Art and Design
outcome: Work within relevant frameworks using a broad range of media, developing independence in exploring ideas and refining intentions.

unit: 2c Core content of A Level Art and Design
outcome: Explain why understanding context helps explore ideas, feelings and meanings.

unit: 2c Core content of A Level Art and Design
outcome: Show contextual understanding through critical evaluation in research, written analysis and practical work, including historical and contemporary practitioners, industries, cultures and events.

unit: 2c Core content of A Level Art and Design
outcome: Show critical and contextual understanding throughout all processes and outcomes.

unit: 2c Core content of A Level Art and Design
outcome: Show awareness of the roles, functions, audiences and consumers of art, craft and design.

unit: 2c Core content of A Level Art and Design
outcome: Extend understanding of context through a related study of art theory, genre, subject matter, movement or historical framework.

unit: 2c Core content of A Level Art and Design
outcome: Understand the importance of ongoing development and refinement and the links between practical and written material.

unit: 2c Core content of A Level Art and Design
outcome: Identify and acknowledge all sources in a bibliography.

unit: 2c Core content of A Level Art and Design
outcome: Know the broad range of media and approaches available, including traditional, digital and emerging technologies.

unit: 2c Core content of A Level Art and Design
outcome: Reflect critically on art, craft and design to place own work in a framework of advanced study.

unit: 2c Core content of A Level Art and Design
outcome: Show progression of ideas through sketchbooks, workbooks, journals, digital or audio presentations.

unit: 2c Core content of A Level Art and Design
outcome: Take an applied approach, working to a brief and reflecting professional practice, constraints, audiences and clients.

unit: 2c Core content of A Level Art and Design
outcome: Use drawing to record, communicate and visualise intentions, ideas and emotions, developing forms of drawing suited to the specialism.

unit: 2c Core content of A Level Art and Design
outcome: Recognise drawing can take forms such as mark making, stitch, collage, storyboarding and 2D or 3D designs.

unit: 2c Core content of A Level Art and Design
outcome: Record experiences and observations through drawing or other visual forms.

unit: 2c Core content of A Level Art and Design
outcome: Research, gather, select and organise visual and other information.

unit: 2c Core content of A Level Art and Design
outcome: Explore resources and analyse, discuss and evaluate images, objects and artefacts, making independent judgements.

unit: 2c Core content of A Level Art and Design
outcome: Use knowledge of others' work to extend thinking and inform own work.

unit: 2c Core content of A Level Art and Design
outcome: Generate and explore lines of enquiry with suitable media and techniques.

unit: 2c Core content of A Level Art and Design
outcome: Make images and artefacts, review and modify work, and develop ideas in light of evaluations.

unit: 2c Core content of A Level Art and Design
outcome: Organise and communicate ideas and solutions in visual, tactile or sensory forms.

unit: 2c Core content of A Level Art and Design
outcome: Understand relevant materials, processes, technologies and resources.

unit: 2c Core content of A Level Art and Design
outcome: Understand how ideas, feelings and meanings are conveyed and interpreted in images and artefacts.

unit: 2c Core content of A Level Art and Design
outcome: Understand how images and artefacts relate to the time, place and social and cultural contexts in which they were made.

unit: 2c Core content of A Level Art and Design
outcome: Understand continuity and change in genres, styles and traditions.

unit: 2c Core content of A Level Art and Design
outcome: Use a working vocabulary and specialist terminology.

unit: 2c Summary of specialisms and areas of study
outcome: Name the seven specialisms: Combined, Fine Art, Graphic Communication, Photography, Textile Design, Three-Dimensional Design, and Critical and Contextual Studies.

unit: 2c Summary of specialisms and areas of study
outcome: Combined Specialisms: work in two or more specialisms, choosing areas of study within or across them.

unit: 2c(i) Art, Craft and Design: Combined Specialisms (H600)
outcome: Explore, research and acquire techniques in a range of 2D and 3D processes and media.

unit: 2c(i) Art, Craft and Design: Combined Specialisms (H600)
outcome: Produce 2D and/or 3D work evidencing at least two specialisms, using traditional or digital methods.

unit: 2c(i) Art, Craft and Design: Combined Specialisms (H600)
outcome: Combine one area of study across two specialisms or different areas from different specialisms.

unit: 2c(i) Art, Craft and Design: Combined Specialisms (H600)
outcome: Apply space, rhythm, structure and scale suited to the chosen specialisms.

unit: 2c(i) Art, Craft and Design: Combined Specialisms (H600)
outcome: Apply formal elements: colour, line, tone, texture, shape and form.

unit: 2c(i) Art, Craft and Design: Combined Specialisms (H600)
outcome: Select, edit and develop ideas using suitable visual language and terminology.

unit: 2c(i) Art, Craft and Design: Combined Specialisms (H600)
outcome: Manipulate imagery through transposition, composition and layering.

unit: 2c(i) Art, Craft and Design: Combined Specialisms (H600)
outcome: Use conventions and genres such as portraiture, landscape, studio ceramics or installation.

unit: 2c(i) Art, Craft and Design: Combined Specialisms (H600)
outcome: Use a range of processes and techniques in traditional or digital media for research, exploration and final outcomes.

unit: 2c(i) Art, Craft and Design: Combined Specialisms (H600)
outcome: Understand technologies, materials and processes, and continuity and change in genres and traditions.

unit: 2c(i) Art, Craft and Design: Combined Specialisms (H600)
outcome: Understand how meanings are conveyed and how work relates to its time, place and culture, using specialist vocabulary.
